Removing each of 2m selected edges has precisely two feasible incident insertions, changing either the center or hole, proving 4m degree and 2m*N_m edges. Swaps on a connected bouquet of m squares generate all label placements, proving connectivity and vertex transitivity. Each state is in m center-change and m hole-change triangles and no others, giving 2m*N_m/3 triangles. Independent direct enumeration of 12 optima at m=1 and 630 at m=2 confirms degrees and triangle counts, but the all-m proof is structural.
